sources.title: On the Legal Status of Foreigners and Stateless Persons
sources.officialityEvidence: The Verkhovna Rada legislation database publishes Ukraine's operative Foreigners Law, including its visa baseline and legal/treaty exception.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Foreigners and stateless persons enter Ukraine with a passport document and a visa, unless otherwise provided by law or treaty.

sources.title: Requirements for issuing visas in electronic form
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine / Verkhovna Rada legislation database
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Rada record for MFA Order No. 558 includes Annex 3 as the named nationality list for electronic visas.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Перелік держав, громадянам яких оформлюються візи в електронній формі, наведено в додатку 3.

sources.title: e-Visas for certain countries
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs, Defence, Development Cooperation and Foreign Trade, Luxembourg
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Luxembourg Government page was last updated 7 January 2026 and specifically names Ukraine in its e-Tourist Visa warning.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Luxembourg nationals need to apply for an e-Tourist Visa before their travel.
